name: vidyalaya
description: MCP server wrapping vidyalaya-office: generate and parse DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, and PDF documents.

tools.name: create_docx
tools.description: Create a .docx Word document with a title and body paragraphs.

paragraphs.description: List of paragraph strings to append to the document.

output_path.description: Optional absolute path for the output .docx file.

path.description: Absolute path to the created .docx file.

tools.name: create_xlsx
tools.description: Create a .xlsx spreadsheet with a named sheet, optional headers, and data rows.

rows.description: List of rows; each row is a list of cell values.

headers.description: Optional column headers prepended before data rows.

output_path.description: Optional absolute path for the output .xlsx file.

path.description: Absolute path to the created .xlsx file.

tools.name: create_pptx
tools.description: Create a .pptx presentation with a cover slide and content slides. Returns base64-encoded file and file path.

title.description: Presentation title shown on the cover slide.

slides.description: List of content slides to add after the cover.

output_path.description: Optional absolute path for the output .pptx file.

path.description: Absolute path to the created .pptx file.

tools.name: export_pdf
tools.description: Convert a .docx or .pptx file to PDF using LibreOffice headless.

input_path.description: Absolute path to the source .docx or .pptx file.

output_dir.description: Optional output directory for the PDF (defaults to same dir as input).

path.description: Absolute path to the generated PDF file.

tools.name: parse_docx
tools.description: Parse a .docx file and extract its title and paragraph text.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the .docx file to parse.

paragraphs.description: List of non-empty body paragraph strings.

path.description: Absolute path to the parsed file.
